frontmatter_snapshot.summary: MWG derives the firm's production function from a production set; single-output case f(z) gives the maximum amount of output producible from input bundle z; returns-to-scale classified via homogeneity (CRS = degree-1 homogeneity), and the Cobb-Douglas form f(z1,z2) = z1^a z2^b has CRS iff a+b=1, IRS for a+b>1, DRS for a+b<1.
